$comment: M3 vortex-lattice and drag build-up references (sources S14-S17 in ../sources.md). No value was produced by running llull.

bertin_smith_swept_wing.source: S14: Bertin J. J., Smith M. L., Aerodynamics for Engineers, 3rd ed., Prentice Hall 1998, VLM worked example (p. 291 in that edition); value quoted by Melin T., A Vortex Lattice MATLAB Implementation for Linear Aerodynamic Wing Applications (KTH 2000), whose Tornado code reproduces it

geometry.horseshoe: bound vortex on the quarter-chord line, control point at three-quarter chord, trailing legs parallel to the x axis

tolerance.why: the book rounds its circulations to 4 digits; the method and lattice are the same

elliptic_wing_lifting_line.source: S7: Prandtl / Glauert lifting line, elliptic loading: CL_alpha = a0 / (1 + a0 / (pi AR)), e = 1; a0 = 2 pi (thin airfoil)
elliptic_wing_lifting_line.use: asymptotic check: lifting-surface (VLM) results approach lifting-line theory as AR grows; span efficiency -> 1 with spanwise refinement

quarter_chord_aerodynamic_centre.source: S6/S7: thin-airfoil theory, the aerodynamic centre of a flat-plate section is at the quarter chord; an unswept, untapered high-aspect-ratio wing has its neutral point there

drag_buildup.source: S15: Raymer D. P., Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach (AIAA), eq. 12.26 (laminar Cf 1.328/sqrt(Re)), eq. 12.27 (turbulent Cf 0.455 / (log10 Re)^2.58 / (1 + 0.144 M^2)^0.65), eq. 12.30 (wing / tail form factor [1 + 0.6/(x/c)_m (t/c) + 100 (t/c)^4][1.34 M^0.18 (cos Lambda_m)^0.28]), as implemented and cited in OpenAeroStruct viscous_drag.py; S16: OpenVSP parasite-drag documentation for Hoerner 1965 (wing 1 + 2 t/c + 60 (t/c)^4; body 1 + 1.5/FR^1.5 + 7/FR^3) and Torenbeek 1982 (wing 1 + 2.7 t/c + 100 (t/c)^4; body 1 + 2.2/FR^1.5 + 3.8/FR^3); mixed laminar / turbulent friction: OpenAeroStruct (S15) Cf = (Cf_lam(k Re) - Cf_turb(k Re)) k + Cf_turb(Re)
drag_buildup.grade: A (formulas cross-checked in two places: Raymer quotes + OpenAeroStruct source; Hoerner / Torenbeek: OpenVSP documentation)
drag_buildup.notVerified: Raymer fuselage (1 + 60/f^3 + f/400) and nacelle (1 + 0.35/f) form factors and the interference factor Q tables were not confirmed from a readable source: not built; Q is an input (default 1, flagged)
